#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 1000000007;

ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    return a == 0 ? b : (b > a ? gcd(b % a, a) : gcd(b, a));
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    
    vector<ll> dp(2 * n + 1, 0);
    ll total = 0;
    dp[0] = 1;
    
    for (int p = 1; p <= 2 * n; ++p) {
        vector<ll> ndp(2 * n + 1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * n; ++i) {
            ndp[i + 1] = (ndp[i + 1] + dp[i]) % MOD;
            if (i - 1 >= 0) {
                ndp[i - 1] = (ndp[i - 1] + dp[i]) % MOD;
                if (p % 2 == 0 && (2 * n - p) >= i - 1) {
                    total = (total + dp[i]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        dp = move(ndp);
    }
    
    cout << total % MOD << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
